## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 400 invitations during the reporting period. Attendance was 59, representing a rate of 14.8 per cent of those invited. This provides a clear comparison between the number of invitations issued and the number of people who attended. The attendance result should be considered alongside the contact activity described below, which supported communication with invitees and provided reminders about the outreach opportunity.

The figures indicate that attendance did not include all people who received an invitation. They are presented together to support routine monitoring of invitation and attendance activity across the River Districts.

## Contact

SMS contact was sent to 347 invitees. A reminder was also sent to 347 invitees. The matching totals show the recorded scale of both contact activities and provide a consistent basis for reviewing outreach delivery.

These figures should be retained with the attendance information for local monitoring and future reporting. The report was prepared by G. Evans.
